lines.text: A sign on the wall: PUSH EVERY CRATE ONTO A GLOWING PAD.
Walk into a crate to push it. If a crate gets stuck, pull a cord to start over.
A pull cord. A little sign says: STUCK? PULL ME.
Clunk. Every crate slides back to where it started.
Iron bars with a glowing lock. The lock is shaped like a crate.
Click! The first gate slides open.
Click, click! The second gate slides open.
Click, click, CLICK! In the corner, a golden chest rises out of the stand.
You open the golden chest. Inside is a star cookie, still warm.
